title: 5-Stage Antagonistic Review Pipeline with Synthesizer Fan-Out/Fan-In and In-Thread Remediation
author: Jim Quinn, Elise Ewing, Dave Rensin (Google LLC, 2026; synthesized by Brain Harness)

claims.assertion: A robust spec review requires a staged multi-phase pipeline where each phase applies a specialized rubric: Initial Zoom Out (simplicity), Naive Comprehension (self-containment), Critic (scale/failure modes), Intermediate Zoom Out (scope creep guard), and Implementation Readiness (concreteness).

Subagent fan-out/fan-in coordination must be governed by an intermediate synthesizer persona that spawns concurrent reviewers, normalizes disparate natural language findings, deduplicates overlapping issues, and ranks by severity (Blocker, Major, Nit).

After each review phase, human-in-the-loop tri-state checkpoint gates allow immediate in-thread remediation (via egm-resolve) to patch the spec in the Elephant context before advancing to subsequent stages.
